# Check the inputs

Run:

```bash
python scripts/python/run_workflow.py --data-dir data/my-study --output-dir results/my-study --check-only
```

The command will fail until your two input files exist and satisfy the contract. Compare counts and quality ranges with the source, and justify MAF/INFO thresholds. Setting `summary_scope` to `selected_variants` suppresses global calibration diagnostics; it does not recover the omitted associations.
